{"content": "# Statement of Contributions to the Northwind Go Logging Library

**Prepared for:** Tomás Alvarez
**Period covered:** 3 March 2025 (start of employment at Northwind) to the most recent commit in the repository
**Source:** The repository's git commit history (private repository). Every item below is a commit recorded under the name "Tomás Alvarez" with the work email address tomas.alvarez@northwind.example.

## About the library

The repository is a Go logging library. Its history shows it was built on a widely used open-source logging library (logrus), which has hundreds of contributors who worked on it long before 2025. The work described below is only Mr. Alvarez's own additions to it. It is not the whole library.

## Summary

Since 3 March 2025, Mr. Alvarez has made **four commits** to the library:

| Date (as recorded) | What the commit did | Size of change |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March 2025 | Added a "trace-ID hook" for passing a trace identifier through the logging context, with an accompanying automated test file | 2 new files: 50 lines of code and 34 lines of test |
| 8 April 2025 | Added a file of automatically generated level-name strings, produced with Go's `go generate` tool | 1 new file of 1,803 lines, all machine-generated (see note 1) |
| Date not reliable (see note 2) | Added a "redaction formatter" | 1 new file of 82 lines |
| 12 May 2025 | Moved two existing formatter files into a new `formatters/` directory | File moves on
